scope:
Inspect native head observations at retained states of a completed pickup.

This uses recorded plant states to render an offline visibility diagnostic.
Segmentation is evaluator-only and is not passed to the appearance detector.
No new physical execution, online tracking, or grasp qualification is claimed.

appearance_proposal.scope:
Find a tweezer-shaped RGB-D component without simulator object state.

Inputs are camera pixels, robot-derived camera calibration, a fixed bench map
and declared object dimensions. The dark-material threshold is a provisional
appearance prior; this module does not establish grasp-pose accuracy.
appearance_proposal.source: Native RGB intensity registered onto native depth; own-robot camera frames and fixed bench bounds
